long_description:
Austin and Central Texas's biggest free Festival of Lights celebrates its 10th anniversary - a decade of light, joy, and community!

🎭 Live Performances - 1,000+ performers across Bollywood, Bharatanatyam, Bhangra, Kathak, Garba, folk and fusion dance

🌸 Rangoli (Sand Art) Competition with prizes

🪔 Diya Lighting Ceremony by the Mayor of Round Rock

🏆 Community Recognition Award ceremony

👗 Bollywood Fashion Show by Taj Fashion

💃 Free Bollywood Dance Workshop by Dance Up Austin

🎧 Open Dance Floor with DJ Rahul till close

🛍️ MEGA India Bazaar- 100+ vendors with clothing, jewelry, home decor, art and more

🍛 12+ food stalls - authentic Indian street food, vegetarian friendly, Indian ice creams and shaved ice

🖍️ Kids Art & Painting Competition - 20+ prizes

🏺 Indian artwork display by local artists

👨‍👩‍👧 Stroller friendly · ♿ Wheelchair accessible · 🐕 Pets welcome · 🆓 Always free!

All entry forms and details at www.rrdiwalifest.com
